INTRODUCTION

Use this anchor: Explain Semiconductor Theory within Semiconductor Theory using correct terms and a clear example or calculation. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Electric current is the rate of flow of charge; potential difference (voltage) drives that flow.
• Ohm’s law (ohmic conductors): V = IR.
• Power: P = VI = I²R = V²/R.
• Series: same current through each component; parallel: same voltage across branches.
